0022600210.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 11th in the West and on a two-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak) for the 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Trendon Watford, Trey Murphy III, Yves Missi and Zion Williamson are out for New Orleans, while Gary Payton II, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Will Richard are out for Golden State. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2, though they won the most recent meeting 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
